documents.title: Fictional behaviour sheet: Maria, a client
documents.text:
# Fictional behaviour sheet: Maria, a client

Maria is guarded and answers briefly. She says that she sleeps only four hours a night, but only when she is asked about sleep.
She mentions her night shifts at a warehouse only when she is asked about work.
She never volunteers that she has stopped taking walks; she says so only when asked about exercise or walks.

documents.title: Fictional intake protocol for a counseling service
documents.text:
# Fictional intake protocol for a counseling service

Step 1. Greet the client and explain confidentiality.

Step 2. Ask about sleep, then about work, then about support from others.

Step 3. If the client mentions thoughts of self-harm, ask directly about safety and name the crisis line 90101.

A session lasts at most 50 minutes.

Session fees by length: sessions of up to 30 minutes cost 500 kronor, and sessions of up to 45 minutes cost 700 kronor.

documents.title: Fictional Payment Act, chapter 7
documents.text:
# Fictional Payment Act, chapter 7

Section 7.1. Payment is due 30 days after the invoice date.

Section 7.2. Late payment carries interest of 8 percent per year on the amount, counted per day of delay over 365 days, but only after a written reminder has been sent.

Section 7.3. A written reminder must be sent within 10 days after the due date.

Section 7.9. For invoices to consumers payment is due 45 days after the invoice date.

Section 7.5. Interest rates by invoice size: invoices under 10000 carry 8 percent per year; invoices of 10000 or more carry 6 percent per year.

documents.title: Fictional Supply Act, chapter 5: defective goods
documents.text:
# Fictional Supply Act, chapter 5: defective goods

Section 5.1. The buyer must examine the goods within 8 days after delivery.

Section 5.2. A complaint about a defect must be made within 60 days after delivery.

Section 5.3. If the goods are defective the buyer may demand a price reduction of 20 percent of the price.

Section 5.4. No price reduction is allowed if the goods were used after the defect was found.

Section 5.5. In this chapter, defect means that the goods differ from what the contract describes.

documents.title: Fictional Supply Act, chapter 3: delay
documents.text:
# Fictional Supply Act, chapter 3: delay

Section 3.1. If the seller delivers more than 14 days after the agreed date, the buyer may terminate the contract by written notice.

Section 3.2. The buyer must give the notice within 30 days after the delay became known.

Section 3.3. For each day of delay the buyer may claim a penalty of 0.5 percent of the price, but at most 10 percent of the price.

Section 3.4. The right to terminate does not apply if the delay was caused by the buyer.

Section 3.5. In this chapter, delay means that the goods are delivered after the agreed date.
